title: State ledger of the notes
description: One JSON line per tracked note in state/notes-status.jsonl: the state of a note of a frozen ledger, which is never edited, or of a finding of a critical panel that became a correction. The validator (p-notes) requires exactly one line per note of the ledger passed with --notes, and a version in closed_in for a closing status. It is living state, not history: a change of status edits the line of that note, and the changelog records the change.

ref.description: 'notes:<n>', the n-th note (1-based, in file order) of the ledger passed with --notes, or 'panel:<version>:<id>', a finding of the critical panel that reviewed that version.

closed_in.description: The method version that closed it; required for fixed and out of scope.

summary.description: What the note asked and where it was closed, or why it stays open; one line.
